Glossary for this site:

- **Playground** — free editor at [Playground](../../try/index.html); no grading.
- **Kata** — graded exercise (prompt + Check) at [Katas](../../try/kata.html).
- **Walkthrough** — tutorial prose with the same live editor and optional Check (this page).

## 1. Run a frame

The fence below is wired to the `hello-frames` kata. Edit if you like, press play to run, or the check mark to grade against expected stdout.

```{.python .live kata="hello-frames"}
frames = "\n".join(
    [
        ";;; ── frames ──",
        "1 | 1 2 3 +\t; 2 3 4",
        "1 2 3 +\t; [1‿2‿3 +]",
        "2 | 3 +\t; 5",
        "1 | 1 2 3 [-] swap-args\t; 1 2 3 - 1",
    ]
)
print(fpl.run.default.src(frames), end="")
```

## 2. Open the playground

Anything you want to try without a prompt belongs in the [Playground](../../try/index.html). Share with the `#c=` hash.

## 3. Grade the same kata on its page

Open [Hello frames](../../try/kata.html?id=hello-frames), press **Check**. Same starter, same expected file under `learn/kata/hello-frames/`.
